codeReview.summary: The new retry endpoint, service wiring, and focused route tests are present, but the implementation is not correctly integrated with the existing UI call path: the client still sends the delivery provider message ID instead of the delivery-log row ID the API validates. As shipped, operator retries from the delivery log will hit the new endpoint with an invalid identifier and fail before any resend logic runs.

issues.description: `retryEmailDelivery` is called with `pendingRetryAttempt.messageId`, but the new API contract requires `deliveryLogId` (the `email_delivery_log.id`) and rejects non-UUID values. Delivery-log attempts expose `messageId` as the provider message identifier, so real retry actions will POST the wrong ID and receive `400 INVALID_REQUEST` instead of resending the failed/bounced email.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The delivery-log attempt DTO used by the Email Delivery UI does not expose the underlying `email_delivery_log.id`, even though the retry API contract is keyed by that ID. This mismatch forced the worker to wire the client to `messageId`, which is a different field with different semantics.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: server/emails/email-delivery-log.ts:23-31 defines `EmailDeliveryLogEntry.id` separately from `messageId`; src/components/features/email-delivery/OpsEmailDeliveryClient.tsx:715 sends `pendingRetryAttempt.messageId`; the feature description in mission features.json requires POST body `{ deliveryLogId: string }`.

summary: Review failed: although commit `7eec49d4` adds the retry route and server-side resend helpers, the UI integration still passes `messageId` instead of the required delivery-log entry ID, so the new endpoint cannot succeed from the existing retry action flow.
